as_told.title: Jake Barber's team contracted to retrieve downed craft

plain: A man named Jake Barber says he was part of a team that recovered downed non-human craft, a job the field calls crash retrieval, and that the team used people with psychic powers to bring the craft in. If true, the government would be using the mind as a tool against these objects. Michels first tells it from a story by the journalist Ross Coulthart on the TV channel NewsNation, about "people psychically calling in" exotic material. Later he adds that such people were called P3s, "people with psionic predisposition potentials", meaning psychic gifts, who "act as the bridge," and he credits a guest named Michael Herrera, who says Barber's team was hired to pick up the vehicles and move them to a facility. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb goes further, saying Barber testified that psychic powers can "forcefully land craft or bring them down."
